rows.note: Use this when something is visibly coated or soaked in oil; it is the all-purpose rendering for that physical sense.

example.english: The table is all oily—wipe it clean before we eat.
example.traditional: 張枱油淋淋，抹乾淨先食啦。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 jau4 lam4 lam4 mut3 gon1 zeng6 sin1 sik6 laa1

rows.note: Use this especially for food or cooking that is greasy or contains a lot of oil, rather than for an object visibly smeared with oil.

example.english: This fried rice is too oily for me to eat.
example.traditional: 呢碟炒飯太油喇，我食唔落。
example.jyutping: ni1 dip6 caau2 faan6 taai3 jau4 laa3 ngo5 sik6 m4 lok6

rows.note: Use this for someone who acts overly nice or polite in a clearly insincere way.

example.english: You don't have to act all oily when you clearly don't want to help.
example.traditional: 你唔使喺度假惺惺喇，明明唔想幫手。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hai2 dou6 gaa2 sing1 sing1 laa3 ming4 ming4 m4 soeng2 bong1 sau2
